title: Lens Inspection Manual
summary: Scan before acting so unknown blocks, machines, and records become decisions rather than guesses.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: Lens is the player's question tool. It should be used before spending rare materials, touching unknown machinery, or ignoring a suspicious block.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Bind Lens to a comfortable slot and scan common machines near base so you know what normal output looks like before a crisis.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Find an unknown target, scan it, read the result, open related Wiki or Index records, then decide whether to harvest, power, repair, or avoid it.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Scan categories, target hints, and tooltip bridges explain what kind of information Lens can expose for the thing in front of you.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: Index and Wiki give scan results somewhere to link. TutorialCore can report Lens progress, and HoloMap can turn scan discoveries into route notes.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If Lens gives little information, check whether the owning addon is loaded and try scanning adjacent blocks in complex machines.
